title: Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development
description:
Who we are
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 .
 Hiring and how we work
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
 .
 See yourself at Twilio
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development
 About the job
 This position is needed to build and lead the live learning experiences that shape how Twilions grow, lead, and work together. You will design and facilitate Twilio's development programs, design and lead leadership team offsites, and serve as an internal coach to leaders and emerging talent around the globe.
 Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Development, you will spend most of your time in the room, virtual or in person, with Twilions: designing programs, facilitating sessions, guiding leadership teams through high-stakes offsites, and coaching leaders through pivotal growth moments. The ideal candidate is an expert facilitator and credentialed coach who designs with rigor, reads a room in real time, and turns every session into measurable behavior change.

title: Founding Channel Sales Coordinator
description:
The opportunity
 We’re building our reseller channel in Japan from the ground up. As our first Channel Sales Coordinator, you’ll help turn early partner relationships into a repeatable program. You’ll keep onboarding, contracts, training, and day-to-day requests moving while helping us improve the processes behind them.
 This is a hands-on role with room to grow. You’ll do well here if you take initiative, enjoy working with people, and can make progress before every process is fully defined.
 What you’ll do
 Coordinate reseller onboarding, from initial paperwork through training and launch readiness.
 Prepare and track contracts, partner records, and other sales administration.
 Help partners get the information and support they need to start selling.
 Work with sales, operations, and other teams to resolve partner questions and remove blockers.
 Keep partner activity, next steps, and reporting accurate and up to date.
 Spot gaps in the partner experience and help build better workflows as the channel grows.
 What you’ll bring
 Experience in sales coordination, partner operations, sales support, or a related role.
 Fluent Japanese and English, with the ability to work confidently with partners and colleagues in both languages.
 Strong organization and follow-through across multiple priorities.
 A proactive, resourceful approach to work that does not yet have a playbook.
 Clear communication and a collaborative working style.
 Interest in building a reseller program and growing your career in channel sales.
 Application Guidelines
 Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

title: Head of Channel Sales Japan
description:
The opportunity
 We’re building our reseller channel in Japan from the ground up. We’re looking for a strategic leader to decide where to focus, turn market opportunities into a clear plan, and drive the changes needed to make that plan work.
 You’ll roll up your sleeves, work across teams to shape our route to market, test ideas, remove barriers to growth, and build a channel that can scale. You’ll have the freedom to define the approach - and the responsibility to adapt it as you learn.
 Strategy and Leadership
 Set the strategy for growing our reseller channel in Japan, including which customer segments, partner types, and opportunities to prioritize.
 Turn the strategy into focused initiatives with clear goals, owners, and measures of success.
 Assess market potential and performance to decide where to invest, what to change, and when to scale.
 Design the commercial approach, including the partner proposition, incentives, sales model, and measures of partner success.
 Lead cross-functional work across sales, product, marketing, operations, and other teams to remove barriers to growth.
 Build the processes and capabilities needed to take the channel from an early-stage effort to a repeatable business.
 Share a clear view of progress, risks, and recommendations with senior stakeholders.
 Build and lead a team as the channel develops.
 Reseller channel
 Drive the development and execution of a holistic reseller strategy — from channel partners that drive new seller acquisition.
 Oversee Partner Managers in end-to-end partnership execution: business development, negotiation, launch, and ongoing management.
 Determine and prioritize the appropriate mix of partner benefits, incentives, and co-marketing/sales opportunities to secure high-value deals.
 Advocate for resellers while balancing Square's commercial goals and product roadmap.
 What you’ll bring
 15+ Years of experience developing commercial or go-to-market strategy and delivering measurable growth.

title: Senior Physical Security Operations Manager
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
 About the team + role
 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
 At Robinhood, the Physical Security team lives by a core value: Safety Always. We are dedicated to safeguarding our employees, workspace, and customers—putting their safety and security first in all our actions. We are dedicated to protecting people, assets, and the Robinhood brand while maintaining operational resilience across all environments.
We're looking for a Senior Physical Security Operations Manager to drive global security programming across multiple countries, time zones, and complex third-party vendor workforces. In this critical role, you'll take a hands-on approach to shape and implement security policies, manage our uniformed security officers and emergency response team members, manage event security strategy, handle budgets, conduct facility risk assessments, and lead training initiatives for Robinhood’s global Physical Security Operations team. You'll play a key part in helping Robinhood prevent, respond to, and recover from security incidents—protecting both our people and our spaces. In this role, you will report directly to the Director of Physical Security.
